column3: “Palace administrator” specifies being over the house.
“You claim” replaces “I say”; “empty words” renders the image of a word of lips.
“Repel” renders turning back the face of an officer.
“Urine” renders the idiom “water of their feet”; “only” and “destined” make the restriction and purpose explicit.
“The god of any nation” restructures the plural gods, each rescuing his own land.
“Palace administrator” specifies being over the house.
